Title: Successfully update an existing shop holiday with a new date and reason
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner. The shop has at least one existing holiday recorded (e.g., holiday ID 101 with date 2024-12-25 and reason 'Christmas').
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Holidays' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Locate the holiday with ID 101 in the list of existing holidays. 3. Click the 'Edit' button next to the holiday. 4. Change the holiday date to 2024-12-26. 5. Update the reason to 'Boxing Day'. 6. Click 'Save' to confirm the changes.

Test Data: Holiday ID: 101, New Date: 2024-12-26, New Reason: 'Boxing Day'
Expected Result: A success message 'Holiday updated successfully for shop [shop name]' is displayed. The holiday list refreshes, and the updated holiday now shows the new date (2024-12-26) and reason ('Boxing Day').

Title: Fail to update an existing shop holiday to a date that already has a holiday for the same shop
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner. The shop has two existing holidays: one on 2024-12-25 (ID 101) and another on 2024-12-31 (ID 102).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Holidays' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Locate the holiday with ID 101 in the list of existing holidays. 3. Click the 'Edit' button next to the holiday. 4. Change the holiday date to 2024-12-31 (the date of the other holiday). 5. Click 'Save' to confirm the changes.

Test Data: Holiday ID: 101, New Date: 2024-12-31 (conflicting date)
Expected Result: An error message 'Shop already has a holiday on 2024-12-31' is displayed. The holiday is not updated, and the original date (2024-12-25) remains unchanged in the list.
